prerequisites: Successful completion of modules to be completed in the 1st and 2nd semesters according to the study plan
Fundamentals of Process Engineering and Plastics Processing (recommended)

learning_outcomes.text: The event should enable the plastics engineer to select the right plastic depending on the product's requirement profile.
Furthermore, material-specific processing instructions and peculiarities are discussed in order to be able to identify material-specific problems in plastic components.
Students are able to design and construct products in a plastic-appropriate manner.

syllabus_topics: Structural properties of macromolecules and polymers
Various physical properties of solid plastics
assessment_rules: The module final exam must be passed to be awarded ECTS credits. The exam format can be a written exam (180-240 minutes) or an oral exam (45-60 minutes). The module's ECTS credits are weighted by factor 1 for the overall grade.
